note: Published tags that attest to a freeze they do not contain. They are NEVER deleted, moved or recreated: once a tag name has been pushed, reusing it can leave different clones resolving one version to different objects. The mistake is preserved and a corrected version issued instead. Nothing may name a revoked tag as the version in force.
